workflow.claim: Choose a ready task whose dependencies are done. Set status to in_progress, claimedBy to your agent name, and startedAt to an RFC 3339 timestamp before editing.
workflow.finish: Meet every acceptance criterion, record concise evidence, set status to review, and set completedAt. A reviewing agent changes review to done.
workflow.scope: Edit only ownedPaths. Propose contract changes in handoffs/SERVER_AGENT.md; docs/API_CONTRACT.md is frozen.
workflow.verification: Follow the repository local-check policy. Run only a specific changed test file when needed; leave broad verification to CI.

tasks.title: Scaffold the Cloudflare Worker
tasks.summary: Provide a pinned local Wrangler toolchain, D1/R2 bindings, initial migration, and a runnable health route.
acceptanceCriteria: npm installs a local Wrangler binary.
The initial D1 migration applies to local state.
GET /health returns HTTP 200 with ok, environment, and requestId.
README documents local and remote resource setup without credentials.

tasks.title: Implement persistence and cryptographic primitives
tasks.summary: Create D1 repositories for employees, invitations, devices, and calls plus token generation and keyed hashing modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository interfaces hide SQL and enforce UTC timestamps and opaque IDs.
Invitation redemption is atomic, expiring, and single-use.
Device secrets use cryptographically secure randomness and only keyed hashes are persisted.
Call creation is idempotent on deviceId plus fingerprint.
Tests exercise behavior through repository and security module interfaces.

tasks.title: Implement employee, invitation, registration, and heartbeat routes
tasks.summary: Implement admin employee/invitation endpoints and device register, authentication, revocation support, and heartbeat behavior.
tasks.ownershipNote: BE-003 owns the identity repository producer only to publish its existing interface as a named type for typed route-level caching; persistence behavior remains unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests and responses match the frozen contract including requestId.
Registration consumes a valid invitation once and returns the device token once.
Bearer authentication rejects missing, invalid, and revoked credentials.
Heartbeat updates diagnostic fields without turning them into enforcement.
Module tests cover invitation reuse, expiry, token isolation, and revocation.

tasks.title: Implement the recording upload lifecycle
tasks.summary: Implement prepare and complete as an idempotent lifecycle over D1 and private R2 with server-generated object keys.
tasks.ownershipNote: BE-004 also owns the completion repository predicate and its regression to make active-device/employee authorization atomic with the completion write, addressing UploadReview's race finding.
acceptanceCriteria: Prepare validates the media allowlist, size limit, fingerprint, and optional metadata.
Repeated prepare returns the same call and a refreshed upload capability when pending.
Upload authorization is short-lived and scoped to one generated object key.
Complete verifies R2 object existence and plausible size before changing state.
Cross-device fingerprints remain isolated and tests cover invalid transitions.

tasks.title: Implement admin call operations
tasks.summary: Implement filtered cursor pagination, authorized playback/download, and idempotent deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: List filters and the 1 to 100 result limit match the contract and sort newest first.
Cursor pagination is stable when records share a timestamp.
Playback never exposes a permanent or public object URL.
Delete removes R2 content and marks metadata deleted; repeated delete succeeds.
Tests cover filters, authorization, playback expiry, and deletion retries.

tasks.title: Build the pilot admin page
tasks.summary: Build a small responsive UI for onboarding employees and finding, playing, downloading, and deleting recordings.
acceptanceCriteria: UI supports all filters and cursor pagination in the contract.
Pending, failed, unmatched, complete, and deleted states are clear.
Playback refreshes an expiring URL and deletion requires confirmation.
Employee creation and one-time invitation display work without embedding admin secrets.
The page is usable on desktop and mobile widths.

tasks.title: Assemble routes and enforce admin access
tasks.summary: Mount feature modules, standardize request IDs and errors, enforce Cloudflare Access in production, and add contract fixtures.
tasks.ownershipNote: BE-007 also owns local integration documentation/configuration, observability redaction, and the server handoff status section. Remote environment/resource provisioning stays BE-008.
acceptanceCriteria: Every frozen route is mounted and returns the standard error shape.
Production admin routes require a validated Cloudflare Access identity.
The local admin bypass is explicit, secret-backed, and unavailable in production.
Logs redact bearer tokens, invitation codes, signed URLs, and phone numbers.
Fixtures cover every shared integration case in docs/HANDOFF.md.

tasks.title: Provision and document the development deployment
tasks.summary: Create Cloudflare development resources, configure bindings and secrets, deploy, and document Access, retention, rollback, and operations.
tasks.ownershipNote: BE-008 includes package scripts so remote commands always select the named dev environment, matching the updated environment strategy.
acceptanceCriteria: D1 and private R2 resources exist and production IDs are configured without committing secrets.
Remote migrations apply and the deployed health route responds.
Cloudflare Access restricts admin routes to the configured administrator.
R2 retention and billing alerts are documented and the bucket is verified private.
Rollback instructions cover Worker deployment and forward-only D1 recovery.

tasks.title: Verify the end-to-end backend vertical slice
tasks.summary: Prove onboarding, authenticated upload, completion, admin discovery, playback, and deletion against the development deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: One fixture employee registers exactly one device with a single-use invitation.
One fixture recording reaches complete and appears in the filtered admin list.
An authorized administrator can play or download and then delete it.
Unauthorized device and admin requests fail without leaking sensitive data.
Evidence and remaining risks are recorded in the server handoff.

tasks.title: Repair authenticated administrator login
tasks.summary: Diagnose and fix the deployed post-Access 401 without weakening administrator authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: The real Access session reaches the deployed administrator page and API.
Invalid, expired, wrong-issuer and wrong-audience credentials remain rejected.
A focused regression captures the observed failure and temporary diagnostics are removed.

tasks.title: Integrate employee management and stable device enrollment
tasks.summary: Specify the approved additive interface, integrate backend/UI/client slices, and verify device handovers end to end.
acceptanceCriteria: Recordings and employee management are separate views with a complete employee directory.
Stable enrollment uses per-device authentication; SIM metadata is not an authentication factor.
Device reassignment preserves historical recording attribution and requires no employee re-enrollment.
Focused runtime and browser verification prove the implemented flows; hardware-only limitations are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement employee directory and device assignment interfaces
tasks.summary: Add directory/editing, invitation history/revocation, device reporting/reassignment, and history-aware recording attribution.
acceptanceCriteria: All new administrator routes remain guarded and return bounded paginated data without credential hashes.
SIM updates and reassignment retain the enrollment ID and bearer credential.
Reassignments are atomic and historical calls never silently move to the next employee.
Targeted regression cases cover authorization, reassignment and attribution boundaries.

tasks.title: Build employee and enrollment management tab
tasks.summary: Separate recordings and employees, support directory editing, and manage enrolled device assignments without exposing credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Employees without recordings appear and names can be edited.
Read-only SIM numbers, stable enrollment IDs and reassignment/revocation controls are available.
Invitation history/status and one-time enrollment code generation remain clear.
Both views are responsive and existing recording playback/delete behavior is retained.

tasks.title: Persist and expose permission-gated device call history
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated bounded call-history batches are idempotent and isolated by device.
Historical employee attribution follows assignment history without moving existing entries.
Guarded administrator listing supports pagination and filters, including calls without recordings.

tasks.title: Expose call history separately in the administrator workspace
acceptanceCriteria: A separate call-history tab displays calls without requiring an audio file.
Employee, type, number and date filters and cursor pagination use the approved history API.
Existing recordings and employee-management behavior remains available.

tasks.title: Integrate Android content sync with the approved history extension
acceptanceCriteria: Record the additive full-history contract without changing the frozen contract file.
Verify real Android selected-folder upload, durable replay, permission behavior and server listing.
Build an upgrade APK preserving enrollment and explicitly record physical Samsung verification limits.

tasks.title: Unify call history, recording association and enrollment recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Enriched history exposes caller and call-specific line metadata without invented values.
Unified keyset feed includes unambiguous associated recordings and visible unlinked recordings.
Revoked devices and invitations are hidden by default before pagination.
Invitation provenance is explicit and one-use recovery atomically rotates credentials for the same enrollment.

tasks.title: Deliver compact unified calls and employee administration
acceptanceCriteria: Compact unified history shows names, numbers, line identity and inline recording actions.
Recording checkbox filters the unified feed and the separate recordings tab is removed.
Compact employee/device/invitation lists expose provenance, recovery and opt-in revoked filters.

tasks.title: Integrate event-driven native setup and unified administration
tasks.ownershipNote: BE-018 yielded its implementation for review; BE-019 owns final browser-driven admin UI refinement and integration validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Document additive contracts while retaining the frozen API contract.
Exercise event-driven native sync, simplified consent, upgrade and reinstall recovery.
Verify compact admin flows, deploy development and retain explicit physical-device limitations.

tasks.title: Add independent call-log deletion and Linekeep administrator branding
acceptanceCriteria: Administrators can explicitly delete call logs or recordings with accurate confirmation and refreshed results.
Call-log deletion preserves audio as unlinked; recording deletion preserves history and removes audio from the unified feed.
Deleted history cannot reappear through ordinary device replay, and deletion never creates a false recording association.
Visible admin branding is Linekeep without changing resource names or authentication identifiers.

tasks.title: Integrate Linekeep visual identity and verify administrator deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Document the additive deletion contract while leaving the frozen API contract unchanged.
Verify real browser deletion, cancellation, source independence and replay behavior.
Verify polished Linekeep Android Home, Advanced and adaptive icon while retaining consent, visibility and upgrade identity.

tasks.title: Repair Samsung recording association using observed source metadata
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the development Samsung timestamp mismatch using anonymized metadata.
Link only uniquely corroborated same-device and same-employee recordings using source time, duration and filename identity without upload-time guesses.
Preserve conflicting-identity, ambiguity, deletion and both-arrival-order safeguards.
Apply and verify migration backfill against development records without modifying source metadata or audio.

tasks.title: Prepare Linekeep for safe public GitHub publication
acceptanceCriteria: Publish as shubhsherl/linekeep with MIT license, setup instructions, logo and contribution guidance.
Exclude live configuration, credentials, local artifacts and personal deployment details from the first commit.
Provide usable deployment templates and configurable Android backend selection without changing installed application identity.
Verify a sanitized fresh-clone setup, scan publication contents, and push main to the requested public repository.
evidence: Public Linekeep README/logo, MIT license, contributor templates, security guidance and portable backend/Android setup complete.

Private Cloudflare configuration, local Android backend settings, credentials, build products and recordings are excluded; deployment-specific historical notes retained privately outside the repository.

Clean publication snapshot: npm ci and all seven local migrations succeeded. Actual HTTP flow covered health, anonymous-admin rejection, form sign-in with HttpOnly session, employee creation, enrollment, signed synthetic WAV upload/completion, unified feed, byte-exact playback/download, deletion and stale-capability rejection, and device revocation.
Six backend authentication/credential regressions and four Android recording-batch regressions passed; debug APK assembled from the sanitized checkout.
Six Android configuration checks passed: missing/HTTP/non-origin rejection, local fallback, environment override, and Gradle-property precedence with trailing-slash normalization.
Gitleaks 8.30.1 reported no leaks; known private deployment identifiers and broken local Markdown file links were absent from publication candidates.
Created public shubhsherl/linekeep and enabled GitHub private vulnerability reporting. Browser automation was unavailable; local sign-in was verified over HTTP, not visually rendered.

tasks.title: Add daily Linekeep call-summary emails using Cloudflare Cron
acceptanceCriteria: Cloudflare Cron generates a daily midnight-to-6-PM IST summary of undeleted call logs with overall and historical employee statistics.
Mailgun delivery uses private EMAIL_IDS and provider secrets, HTML and plain text, without phone numbers, recordings or unguarded HTTP send routes.
Public setup documents the UTC schedule, opt-in activation and partial-day/late-upload limitations.
Verify real Worker scheduling and D1 aggregation with synthetic data, safe email capture and focused boundary/privacy regressions; enable live delivery only after recipients are approved.
evidence: Six focused reporting regressions passed, including actual workerd scheduled delivery, recipient parsing, native redirect refusal, historical attribution, deletion, unique-contact counts, IST boundaries and private-field exclusion. TypeScript no-emit check passed.

A disposable real Worker/D1 smoke enrolled a synthetic phone, uploaded call history through the HTTP API, invoked a native scheduled event and captured the expected two-call email while excluding a post-cutoff call; provider rejection failed the event.

The existing Mailgun account accepted a synthetic test-mode request without delivering email. Chromium previews at 390px and 760px had no horizontal overflow; synthetic screenshots remain under ignored server/.wrangler/report-verification/.
After explicit recipient approval, provisioned EMAIL_IDS and Mailgun credentials as development Worker secrets and deployed the enabled 30 12 * * * Cron Trigger. Production remains unchanged.
Deployed health returned 200, unauthenticated device heartbeat returned 401, and protected administration redirected to Access with 302. Actual scheduled inbox delivery awaits the next 6 PM IST run.

Public templates remain opt-in and contain no recipient addresses or provider credentials; server setup and handoff document configuration, partial-day limitations and provider-acceptance semantics. Removed the temporary smoke helper.

tasks.title: Customers, employee assignment and WhatsApp chat storage API
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the 2026-10-06 handoff contract exactly: migration, normalization, admin and device endpoints, assignment-scoped access with 404 for unassigned customers.
Customer calls match call_logs by phone_key with recordings and any employee's calls; deleted logs are excluded.
POST device message validates and returns 503 WHATSAPP_NOT_CONFIGURED without storing or sending.
Focused regressions cover normalization, uniqueness, assignment isolation, pagination, call matching and clearing optional fields.
evidence: 11 focused customer regressions (normalization, uniqueness, assignment isolation, pagination, call matching, deleted logs, 503 send) plus call-history, identity, app and report suites: 50/50 pass; tsc clean.
Migration 0008 applied to a development D1 and a sample operator import of customers and chats was verified. Deployed; unauthenticated device access returns 401 and admin returns an Access redirect.

tasks.title: Admin Customers and WhatsApp chats tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Customers tab lists, searches, creates, edits, assigns employees to and archives customers; detail shows WhatsApp messages and calls with recordings and who called.
WhatsApp chats tab lists conversations and shows a read-only thread.
Follows existing admin UI conventions, escapes all customer text, and works at phone and desktop widths.
evidence: Local browser check with imported data: Customers list, detail with messages, Add customer dialog (stored fields and assignment verified through the API) and WhatsApp chats tab at desktop and 390px without horizontal overflow.
Not yet exercised with real recordings on the customer Calls panel; no devices are assigned customers yet.

tasks.title: Setup QR code and runtime server URL
acceptanceCriteria: Admin shows a scannable QR (server origin + one-time code) for enrollment and recovery invitations.
Android reads the backend URL at runtime (QR or Advanced), locked while enrolled, with host confirmation for scanned servers; a generic APK embeds no URL.
evidence: QR rendered in the admin under its CSP and decoded back to the exact linekeep://enroll URI with an independent decoder; identity/QR/customer/app server tests 24/24; tsc clean; dev Worker redeployed.
Android unit tests pass; generic and dev 0.7.0 APKs built (generic dex has no backend URL). Camera scan and the new Compose screens are not yet run on a device.

tasks.title: Recording retention (TTL) job
acceptanceCriteria: Opt-in daily job deletes recording audio older than RECORDING_RETENTION_DAYS and tombstones the call; call logs are never deleted.
Verified on a development environment before production.
evidence: Six workerd D1/R2 regressions: disabled by default, boundary, recorded-time with receipt fallback, capped backlog drain, missing object, R2 failure retries.

On the deployed dev Worker a one-time Cron removed exactly 3 synthetic expired objects and tombstoned their rows, kept a recent one and all 311 real recordings; temporary cron and test data removed. Production not yet enabled.

tasks.title: Call analytics dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Call analytics tab with filters, KPI cards with period deltas, SVG charts and a leaderboard from an aggregate-only IST endpoint.
evidence: Eight endpoint regressions (IST boundaries, filters, zero-fill, previous-window math, validation, no phone numbers); 113/113 server tests; tsc clean.
Browser-checked on a seeded local database: desktop and 360px without overflow, filters match the API, label overlap fixed. Deployed to dev; production not yet updated.
